Example Sentence: 새해가 되기 전에 목표를 적었어요.
English: before ~ing
Sentence Translation: I wrote down my goals before the new year started.

Example Sentence: 포기라고 하기엔 좀 그렇고요.
English: it's a bit much to call it ~ / hard to say it's exactly ~
Sentence Translation: It's a bit much to call it giving up.

Example Sentence: 이런 식으로 생각을 하다 보니 스트레스를 많이 받았어요.
English: as a result of continuously doing ~ (gradual accumulating result)
Sentence Translation: Thinking this way over and over, I ended up really stressed.

Example Sentence: 부산에서 살았었는데 요즘 서울에서 살고 있어요.
English: used to ~ (but not anymore)
Sentence Translation: I used to live in Busan but these days I live in Seoul.

Example Sentence: 마음을 내려놓고 나니까 마음이 편안해졌어요.
English: upon completing ~, realized/felt that... (completion leading to realization)
Sentence Translation: Once I let it go, I felt at ease.

Example Sentence: 저 혼자서, 세 명이서 여행을 갔었는데.
English: counter/number + together (people doing something as a group)
Sentence Translation: I went alone / the three of us went on a trip.

Example Sentence: 건강을 많이 해칠 정도로 마시는 수준은 아니에요.
English: to the extent that ~
Sentence Translation: I don't drink to the extent that it damages my health.

Example Sentence: 그렇게 마시는 수준은 아니라고 생각해요.
English: not at the level of ~
Sentence Translation: I don't think I'm at that level (of drinking).

Example Sentence: 힘들거나 스트레스받거나 싸우거나 그럴까 봐 걱정했어요.
English: worried that ~ might happen
Sentence Translation: I was worried we might get tired, stressed, or fight.

Example Sentence: 엄마랑 딸이랑 계속 팔짱을 끼고 다닐 테니까.
English: since surely ~ will happen (confident prediction as reason)
Sentence Translation: Since mom and daughter will surely keep walking arm in arm.

Example Sentence: 제가 자리를 뺏진 않았죠.
English: emphatic negation (contraction of 지는 않다 → 진 않다)
Sentence Translation: I didn't exactly steal his spot, right?

Example Sentence: 제가 이렇게 목표를 정해 봤자 시간이 없구나.
English: even if you do ~, it's useless / no point in ~ing
Sentence Translation: Even if I set goals like this, I have no time anyway.

Example Sentence: 나는 시간이 없구나.
English: exclamatory self-realization ending
Sentence Translation: I realize I have no time!

Example Sentence: 2년에 한 번씩 우연히 가게 됐어요.
English: to come to happen naturally / end up ~ing
Sentence Translation: We ended up going once every two years, quite naturally.

Example Sentence: 딸이 있었으면 그렇게 나란히 걷지 못하셨을 거예요.
English: past counterfactual conditional (if X had happened, Y would have happened)
Sentence Translation: If I'd had a daughter, they wouldn't have been able to walk side by side like that.

Example Sentence: 그렇게 나란히 걷지 못하셨을 거예요.
English: to be unable to ~
Sentence Translation: They wouldn't have been able to walk side by side like that.

Example Sentence: 아마 여름 전에 가지 않을까 싶어요.
English: tentative opinion ("I think maybe ~")
Sentence Translation: I think we'll probably go before summer.

Example Sentence: 물론 가시면 어디든 좋을 것 같긴 한데.
English: it's true that ~, but... (concessive)
Sentence Translation: Sure, it'd probably be good wherever you go, but...

Example Sentence: 작은 것들을 그냥 오늘 하면 되는 거니까.
English: it's fine/sufficient if you just do ~
Sentence Translation: Since you can just do the small things today.

Example Sentence: 여행 같은 경우에는 계획도 오래 세워야 돼요.
English: in the case of N / when it comes to N
Sentence Translation: In the case of travel, you also have to plan far ahead.

Example Sentence: 계획도 오래 세워야 되고 해서 가장 먼저 떠오르는 거 같아요.
English: and so (one reason among others)
Sentence Translation: Because you also have to plan ahead and things like that, it's the first thing that comes to mind.

Example Sentence: 엄마랑 딸이랑 계속 팔짱을 끼고 다닐 테니까.
English: to link arms
Sentence Translation: Since mom and daughter will keep walking arm in arm.

Example Sentence: 나중에 일주일 지나니까 두 분이서 보조를 맞춰서 같이 걸어가셨어요.
English: to match one's pace/step with someone
Sentence Translation: After about a week, the two of them started walking in step together.

Example Sentence: 저는 그림이 그려지네요.
English: I can picture it, I can imagine it (literally "the picture gets drawn")
Sentence Translation: I can just picture it.

Example Sentence: 예를 들어서 딸이랑 둘이서만 여행 가기.
English: for example
Sentence Translation: For example, going on a trip with just my daughter.
